title.zh: 赌场管制（问题赌博——保留与过渡规定）条例 2026
title.en: Casino Control (Problem Gambling — Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Casino Control (Problem Gambling — Saving and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 21 September 2026.

heading.en: References to corresponding exclusion or visit limit

text.en:
3. As from 21 September 2026, any reference in any written law or document to any exclusion order, visit limit or exclusion under the old law mentioned in the first column of the following table is to be read as a reference to the exclusion order, visit limit or exclusion under the new law mentioned in the second column corresponding thereto (called in these Regulations the corresponding exclusion or visit limit):
First column
Second column
Exclusion order, visit limit or exclusion under old law
Corresponding exclusion or visit limit under new law
(a)Family exclusion order under section 162(1)
Family exclusion order under section 162(1)
(b)Visit limit under section 163A(4)
Family visit limit under section 163A(4)
(c)Provisional family exclusion order under section 164(1)
Provisional family exclusion order under section 164(1)
(d)Exclusion order under section 165(1)
Third party exclusion order under section 165(1)
(e)Visit limit under section 165(1)
Third party visit limit under section 165(1)
(f)Exclusion under section 165A(3)
Exclusion under section 165A(3)
(g)Self‑exclusion under section 165A(4)
Self‑exclusion under section 165AA(2)
(h)Visit limit under section 165B(3)
Voluntary visit limit under section 165B(3)

heading.en: Orders and visit limits, etc., made under old law continue under new law and subject to new law
Pending applications made under old law to be dealt with under new law
Proceedings initiated by Committee for exclusion order or visit limit under section 165 of old law continue under new law

text.en:
6. As from 21 September 2026 —
(a)any written notice served on a person before that date giving the person a reasonable opportunity to object (under section 165(5) of the old law) to an exclusion order or a visit limit, is to be treated as a written notice served on a person giving the person a reasonable opportunity to object (under section 165(5) of the new law) to a third party exclusion order or a third party visit limit, as the case may be; and
(b)any proceedings pursuant to the written notice mentioned in paragraph (a) continue under the new law as if they were proceedings relating to the corresponding exclusion or visit limit.

heading.en: Pending appeals made under old law to be dealt with under new law

text.en: 7. As from 21 September 2026, any appeal made under section 165(10) of the old law against an exclusion order or visit limit and for which a decision is pending immediately before that date, continues and is to be dealt with as if it were an appeal made under section 165(10) of the new law against a third party exclusion order or third party visit limit, respectively.
